The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
I have been using drugs for about 3 years, only cannabis. I cannot use cannabis anymore due to monthly drug tests. Shortly after I was first tested, I tried to find some safe alternatives to cannabis. I tried psilocibin mushrooms and alcohol. Alcohol tastes like shit and makes me nauseous. Psilocibin mushrooms are great, but they are currently out of season here.
A good friend of mine said that I could get fucked up off Benadryl. I figured there was no way this could be true. So I went and looked it up and could not believe it was true. After reading some experiences, I decided to give it a try. I went around the corner to the store and bought a pack of Benadryl for $4.99. It contained 24 50mg tablets. I was a little nervous about taking so many pills, so I started with what I thought was a small dose. I took 10 pills (500mg) and waited 30 minutes. I started to feel a bit dizzy and light-headed. After an hour, things were spinning a little more and I felt slight euphoria and drowsiness. I waited another hour to see if it got more intense, but it just stayed at that level.
I decided to go to sleep. The next morning I got up to go to school. I usually take the bus to school, but today the bus seemed rather strange. When the bus would start to move, I would struggle a bit to keep balance (I was standing). Also, whenever the bus started to move, I would get this strange sensation throughout my entire body. The rest of the day was fine.
A week later, I remembered I still had 14 tablets of Benadryl left. So I took them at night again, this time 14 pills (700mg). I felt the same effects as last time, except they were a little more intense. I took a break from diphenhydramine for 2 weeks. I wanted to try it again, but I wanted the experience to be more intense. I went to the store and bought another pack.
As crazy as it sounds, I took the whole pack, which contained 24 pills (1200mg). I was very nervous for 20 minutes because the amount I took seemed like it could kill me. 10 minutes after I calmed down, the effects kicked in. Everything was spinning, slight euphoria, the usual effects I felt. I lied in bed for another 30 minutes, watching TV, a little aggravated that I didnt feel much different from the high dose. I had to take a piss, so I tried to get up, and as my upper body went up, it was pulled right down as if someone put 100 lb weights on my back!
I just said to myself Holy shit, this is amazing! It didnt hurt or anything, I just felt like my body was REALLY heavy. I decided not to try to get up for another 10 minutes, so I stared at the giant wahoo (stuffed fish) on my wall. It started to swim around the room! I just stared at the fish for 15 minutes. Now I really had to pee. I tried to get up again. But this time I held onto my wall. I managed to get my upper body up. Everything was spinning in an extremely intense way. I felt euphoria and I had a really hard time focusing on one topic. It was actually impossible to focus. I proceeded to stand up. I fell right on my face! It didnt hurt at all, I was actually laughing really hard! I tried to stand up again, and the same thing happened. It was impossible to keep balance. Its so hard to explain the sensation that caused this. I felt my legs, but they just could not support me.
I decided it was useless so I crawled to the bathroom. I climbed onto the toilet and had to try to sit on it. When I was trying to sit, my body just kept going left or right until I fell. I managed to hold on to the sink and the seat so I could sit straight and pee. Afterwards, I crawled back into my room and climbed onto the bed. I fell asleep immediately and had a great lucid dream. For those of you who dont know, a lucid dream is when you know you are dreaming, and sometimes you can control what happens in the dream. The day after, I felt the same day after effects, but they were slightly more intense. Later that day, I decided to type this experience and submit it.  My experience was GREAT and will definitely do it again.
